name: grow_submit
description: Add or improve one of your own procedures (a skill) in your grow zone. Pass the whole skill: it replaces any live version of that name. Code checks it; a new skill or a large change is then reviewed by another model after this turn and goes live only if it passes, so report 'staged', not 'saved'. Use it when a kind of task repeats or went badly. Prose only: no scripts.

description.description: One line: when to use this skill

example.description: One line: a request this skill answers

body.description: The procedure, as numbered steps in prose

anchors.description: Optional world facts the procedure rests on
